𝗦𝗘𝗥𝗜𝗘𝗦 𝟮-𝟬? 🇮🇳🔥

India lead the 5-match ODI series 1-0; 2nd ODI today in Wellington.
NZ are without Chapman and Ravindra.

Will Gill's men go 2-0? 👀

#INDvNZ #Cricket

𝗞𝘆𝗮 𝗜𝗻𝗱𝗶𝗮 𝘀𝗲𝗿𝗶𝗲𝘀 𝗺𝗲𝗶𝗻 𝟮-𝟬 𝗸𝗮𝗿𝗲𝗴𝗶? 🇮🇳🔥

👉 Aaj Wellington mein 2nd ODI
👉 India 5-match series mein 1-0 se aage (1st ODI mein 5 wicket, DLS)

Aapko kya lagta hai, Gill ki team 2-0 karegi? Comment karo 👇
